questions.q: How far ahead should I book?
questions.a: Summer Saturdays go a year or more ahead. Fridays, Sundays and winter weddings, often a few months. Check your date on the cover.
A £150 booking fee, which comes off your total. Until then a date is only pencilled.

questions.q: When should I have my trial?
questions.a: Between six months and four weeks before. Your trial page works the dates out from your wedding.
Worked back from your ceremony: everyone else first, you last, with fifteen minutes spare. Before 7am there's an early-start fee.
On my own, up to six or seven before a 2pm ceremony. More than that, a second artist joins and we work two chairs.
Yes, by the hour until the speeches. Most brides take the touch-up kit instead.

questions.q: What if I have sensitive skin or allergies?
questions.a: Tell me when you book. I patch test lash glue at your trial and bring products you've used.

questions.q: Do you set dupattas and jewellery?
questions.a: Yes, as part of the morning, and hijab styling too. Tell me how many events you have.
Free within three miles of Clapham; London and Surrey by zone. Abroad, travel days are quoted.

pages.title: Isolde
pages.description: Isolde is a bridal hair and makeup artist in Clapham, south London.
pages.intro: One bride a day, a trial for every one.

blocks.alt: Isolde lining a bride's lip in a white room

blocks.heading: How I work
blocks.body:
One wedding a day, so I'm never watching the clock on yours. A trial for every bride. Skin first, then everything else.

I work with an assistant on bigger mornings, and with a second artist when a morning needs two chairs.

pages.title: Asian bridal
pages.description: Asian bridal hair and makeup by Isolde: full glam, dupatta and jewellery setting, hijab styling, every event.
pages.intro: Full glam, the dupatta set, the jewellery placed.

blocks.alt: A bride with rose and gold lids, a kundan choker and drop earrings

blocks.heading: Each event
blocks.body:
Mehndi, the wedding day and the reception are booked as separate mornings, each with its own look. A trial covers the wedding-day look; the others we plan from it.

The dupatta and jewellery are set as part of your time in the chair: allow two and a half hours.

blocks.heading: Hijab styling
blocks.body: For you and for your party, on its own or with makeup.

blocks.text: Tell me your events and dates.
